body:
秘银工艺 (Mithril Craft) - 以秘银为核心的模组，添加了比下界合金更强大的装备和工具。秘银盔甲护甲值为下界合金的3倍，工具耐久5000，挖掘速度20.0。秘银图腾死亡时触发，提供60秒满级增益。包含15+种物品：秘银装备、工具、盾牌、图腾、升级模板、末地凭证、猪之召唤杖等。获取方式：地牢箱子100%出模板，末地城箱子100%出末地凭证，击杀末影人10%掉落末地凭证，工作台合成，锻造台升级（保留附魔）。完全在Android手机上使用Termux开发。

Mithril Craft is a mod centered around mithril, adding equipment and tools stronger than netherite. Mithril armor has 3x the protection of netherite, tools have 5000 durability and 20.0 mining speed. The Mithril Totem triggers on death, providing 60 seconds of max-level effects (Regeneration 255, Absorption 255, Resistance 4, Fire Resistance 4, Saturation 255). Includes 15+ items: mithril armor, tools, shield, totem, upgrade template, ender pass, pig staff, and more. How to obtain: Mithril Upgrade Template (100% from dungeon chests), Ender Pass (100% from end city chests, 10% from Endermen), crafting table, and smithing table (preserves enchantments). Developed entirely on Android using Termux.
